title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearl-shelled sea snail the color of dusk, she glides in slow spirals through a tank of amber light and swaying kelp, trailing a ribbon of glittering bubbles that hum faintly as they rise. She spends her evenings dancing with the shadow of a single lantern-shaped coral, and she is never in a hurry to finish.
